text:
Iris: Customer wants a concise rollout spec: EU+APAC phased with token caps and an automated stoplight. Need ops-ready plan.
Ken: Proposal: shadow -> micro-canary -> AB-econ stoplight (GREEN/YELLOW/RED). YELLOW reduces pct, RED triggers immediate route fallback.
Ada: SRE: require 3 consecutive 5m windows for trips. After RED, auto-route to fallback model and lock re-enable for 15m. All events logged with correlation-id.
Marco: Data: sample 500 responses/hr (mix synth+prod). Metrics: p95 latency, err rate, embed drift, cost. Stoplight rules: embed_drift>0.03 OR cost_delta>12% -> YELLOW; persist 30m -> RED.
Ken: Draft snippet:
```
rollout_id: stoplight-eu-apac-2026
phases:
  - shadow: duration=72h
  - micro-canary: eu small pct=1 duration=6h
  - ab-econ: sample_pct=5 duration=48h
stoplight:
  state: GREEN|YELLOW|RED
  hysteresis: 3x5m
flags:
  key: rollout.stoplight.euapac.2026
  per_tenant_opt_in: true
fallback: model-stable-v1
```
Ada: Ops knobs: per-tenant hourly token cap, token-shed -> quantized -> cached; manual per-tenant exclusion endpoint.
ops-bot: Canary started: rollout=stoplight-eu-apac-2026 slice=eu-small pct=1 start=7432109876
Iris: Launch checklist (draft): 72h shadow clean, micro-canaries 24h no trips, AB p<0.05 and cost delta <10%, ops runbook signed. Add blockers to the doc by EOD.
Ken: I'll own flags+routing. Ada will draft runbook. Marco will prepare eval harness.
Iris: Thanks — sync Monday to lock thresholds. :thumbsup:
